infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ZAAL lets your child say Farsi words out loud. Recordings stay on this device and are never uploaded.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ZAAL lets your child photograph toys and rooms so Neli can name them in Farsi. Photos stay on this device and are never uploaded.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ZAAL lets your child choose a photo from the library so Neli can name it in Farsi. Photos stay on this device and are never uploaded.
